## [PUBLIC] Scope

Writing skills define documentation standards, harness advice, and citable-content rules for skill manifests and agent output.

## [PUBLIC] Placement

Add skills here for **documentation quality**, style, and agent-output conventions that apply repo-wide. Runtime QA or state management belong in the parent `core-operations/` root, not this folder.

## [PUBLIC] Constraints

- Avoid operator-specific names and private project tokens.
- Skills MUST document invoke pattern and expected output shape.
